title: Disposition audit note can be written twice after a failed SQLite receipt write and a host restart (needs a caller-keyed idempotent Engram note)
outcome: Disposition audit note can be written twice after a failed SQLite receipt write and a host restart (needs a caller-keyed idempotent Engram note)
acceptance: The retired-check disposition's Engram audit note is written with a deterministic operation identity (from claim, run, disposed run ids and reason), and the recovery/replay path after a failed SQLite receipt write and a host restart reuses that identity so exactly one note exists.

A behavioural test injects a SQLite receipt write failure after the Engram note is acknowledged, simulates restart/replay, and shows exactly one audit note and a consistent SQLite receipt; no text-pinning test.
The fix uses a supported Engram keyed-note operation (filed on Engram) or an exact operation-key recovery read; no refs scan is used as proof of absence.

blockers.detail: Waits on Engram w-bb2a0d6b8a90 (caller-keyed idempotent note); Greg accepted the split 2026-11-27 (mailbox 588693a8 #2932)
